title: OpenAI hit by another outage as ChatGPT, Codex, and APIs stumble together

content_html:
TL;DR

OpenAI’s APIs, ChatGPT, and Codex all reported elevated error rates on Saturday, the fourth incident in four days for the company

OpenAI’s status page reported elevated error rates across its APIs, ChatGPT, and Codex on Saturday, marking the fourth service disruption in four days for the company. Users encountered 503 errors with the internal label “biscuit_baker_service_me_circuit_open,” which prevented requests from reaching OpenAI’s servers. The company moved from investigating to monitoring within an hour, saying it had applied a mitigation and was watching for recovery.

The outage hit all three pillars of OpenAI’s product line simultaneously. The API dashboard listed 12 affected components, ChatGPT showed 15, and Codex flagged four, with ChatGPT posting the weakest recent uptime of any OpenAI product over the past 90 days. The timing is awkward for a company that merged ChatGPT, Codex, and its API into a single platform under Greg Brockman in May, precisely so it could concentrate engineering resources rather than spread them thin.

Saturday’s incident was not an isolated stumble, with OpenAI’s own status history showing elevated API error rates on Thursday, elevated errors in Codex Review on the same day, and elevated error rates in both ChatGPT and API image generation on Wednesday. That run follows a pattern that has persisted since autumn 2025, with the status page logging roughly 166 incidents across about nine months, an average of roughly 18 per month. ChatGPT also suffered a major outage on April 20 and again on July 23, just two days before Saturday’s disruption.

The reliability questions land harder now than they would have a year ago. OpenAI’s agentic products passed 10 million weekly users last week, and ChatGPT Work launched this month with the promise that AI agents can finish multi-step tasks across a user’s apps and files, a proposition that depends on the platform staying up. When a chatbot goes offline, users lose a conversation; when an autonomous agent goes offline mid-task, the consequences cascade through the workflows it was managing.

OpenAI is not alone in this struggle. Anthropic’s Claude went down in June, prompting similar questions about whether the infrastructure behind frontier AI models can keep pace with the demands being placed on it. The difference is one of scale and ambition: OpenAI now serves 900 million weekly active users across a unified platform it is preparing to take public later this year, and every outage chips away at the reliability narrative enterprise buyers need before handing real work to an AI agent.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

OpenAI 的 API、ChatGPT 和 Codex 周六均报告错误率升高，这是该公司四天内发生的第四起事件

OpenAI 的状态页面报告周六其 API、ChatGPT 和 Codex 的错误率上升，这是该公司四天内第四次服务中断。 用户遇到了内部标签为“biscuit_baker_service_me_ Circuit_open”的 503 错误，该错误导致请求无法到达 OpenAI 的服务器。 该公司在一小时内从调查转向监控，并表示已采取缓解措施并正在观察恢复情况。

这次中断同时影响了 OpenAI 产品线的三大支柱。 API 仪表板列出了 12 个受影响的组件，ChatGPT 显示了 15 个，Codex 标记了 4 个，其中 ChatGPT 的正常运行时间是过去 90 天内所有 OpenAI 产品中最弱的。 对于一家在 5 月份将 ChatGPT、Codex 及其 API 合并到 Greg Brockman 领导下的单一平台的公司来说，时机很尴尬，正是为了集中工程资源而不是分散资源。

周六的事件并不是一次孤立的失误，OpenAI 自己的状态历史记录显示周四的 API 错误率升高，同一天 Codex Review 的错误率升高，周三 ChatGPT 和 API 图像生成的错误率升高。 这一事件遵循自 2025 年秋季以来一直存在的模式，状态页面在大约 9 个月内记录了大约 166 起事件，平均每月大约 18 起。 ChatGPT 还在 4 月 20 日和 7 月 23 日遭遇了严重中断，就在周六中断的前两天。

可靠性问题现在比一年前更加困难。 OpenAI 的代理产品上周突破了 1000 万周用户，ChatGPT Work 于本月推出，承诺人工智能代理可以跨用户的应用程序和文件完成多步骤任务，这一主张取决于平台的持续运行。 当聊天机器人离线时，用户就会失去对话；当自主代理在执行任务时离线时，后果会通过它所管理的工作流程级联起来。

OpenAI 并不是唯一陷入这场斗争的人。 Anthropic 的 Claude 在 6 月份下台，引发了类似的问题，即前沿人工智能模型背后的基础设施能否跟上对其提出的要求。 区别在于规模和雄心：OpenAI 现在通过一个准备在今年晚些时候上市的统一平台为 9 亿周活跃用户提供服务，而每次中断都会削弱企业买家在将实际工作交给人工智能代理之前所需的可靠性叙述。
